notes: Find variants understands transparency: images with see-through parts (like PNGs with a clear background) keep them. Clear and white are no longer treated as the same, and the base and layers keep the exact transparency, soft edges included.

New switch “Understand see-through effects” (on by default): shadows, blush, glows and tints become real see-through layers (the colour plus how see-through it is), so they also look right over other layers, for example a shadow over a different hair colour. Solid additions and plain colour swaps (like a new eye colour) stay solid.
The preview marks options that became see-through.
